svg.title: Normal and cystic fibrosis sequencing gels: compact schematic
svg.desc: Schematic of Riordan et al., Science 245:1066 (1989), Fig. 4. B primer reads the forward strand and D primer the reverse strand. Normal bases TTC and GAA are bracketed in orange; open arrowheads show the deletion junctions in cystic fibrosis. All original sequence calls and bands are retained. Empty vertical gaps between successive band rows are reduced by 90 percent, preserving band thickness. Band spacing and intensity are schematic.
